targets.title: Contracting out: for what? With whom?
targets.evidence_quote: We replicate Ferris and Graddy's classic 1986 study of local government production and sector choice to assess how public procurement has changed over the past 35 years.
targets.outcome_quote: Our findings show that today, contracting out is more commonly used across 25 local government service areas. In contrast to the original study, much of the growth has been in government‐to‐government contracts.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The abstract explicitly contrasts contracting patterns with the original. No overall verdict or confirmed comparison is available; fuller results might support a mixed verdict.
